rationale: For a recipe and meal planning app, food should be the hero. A warm, organic, light theme (Off-white/Bone, Terracotta, Sage) creates an appetizing, welcoming, and trustworthy environment for home cooks while keeping the structured UI required for a SaaS meal planner.

typography.rationale: Playfair Display gives an editorial, high-end cookbook feel for recipe titles and primary headings. Manrope provides clean, geometric readability for complex data (nutrition, ingredients, UI controls).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 for cards. p-12 for page sections.

surface_styles.recipe_card: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-[#E5E0D8] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
surface_styles.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 border-b border-[#E5E0D8]

components.buttons: rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
components.inputs: rounded-2xl border-[#E5E0D8] bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#52796F]/30 focus:border-[#52796F] px-4 py-3 shadow-sm
components.tags: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-[#F3F1ED] text-[#5C5955]

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a lighter, more elegant feel to match Playfair Display.

images.description: Abstract warm culinary background texture for the home/ingestion page header area.
AI cooking illustration to show when the LangGraph agent is extracting the recipe.
Breakfast plate with toast, eggs, salad.
Gourmet dish featuring grilled salmon, rice, greens.
Fresh vegetables and eggs on a wooden cutting board.
Red rice and roti bread served with sauces.

instructions_to_main_agent: App must be in French (e.g., 'Ajouter une URL YouTube', 'Planificateur Hebdomadaire').
Install fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS (Playfair Display and Manrope).
Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors provided in this JSON.
Do NOT use generic card components out of the box. Use the provided surface_styles (rounded-3xl, delicate borders).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='extract-recipe-btn').
Use Recharts for the nutrition donut chart, applying the primary/secondary colors.
Maintain high contrast for accessibility (APCA guidelines) especially on the Terracotta CTAs.
